observerRom.diagnosis: Gate-front tuning separates door probing into aim, approach, settle, and Use-hold phases. Use is held across multiple DOOM tics and the door depth thresholds are widened so the agent stays within interaction range instead of oscillating away from the gate.

combatTactics.openArea: circle-strafe while keeping enemy near center and firing controlled bursts
combatTactics.narrowArea: kite backward and sideways to stack enemies for infighting before committing shots
combatTactics.crowdArea: prioritize explosive barrels; barrel hit points are treated as 20 and blast damage falls off across roughly 0-128 map units
